Global eclipse superstitions you didn’t know about

1.🇮🇳 India (IN) – Considered an inauspicious time; fasting is common, indoor stay is advised for pregnant women, and ritual cleansing follows the eclipse.

2.🇨🇳 China (CN) – A dragon is believed to devour the Sun; loud noises are made to scare it away.

3.🇯🇵 Japan (JP) – Once feared as bad luck; now celebrated as a scientific event.

4.🇲🇽 Aztec Civilization (MX) – Seen as angry gods attacking the Sun; protective rituals were performed.

5.🇳🇴 Norse Mythology (NO) – Wolves chase and try to swallow the Sun and Moon.

6.🇹🇭 Thailand (TH) – Shifted from an ominous sign to a public astronomy celebration.

7.🇹🇷 Turkey (TR) – Prayers and noise-making rituals are performed to restore the Sun.

8.🇵🇪 Inca Civilization (PE) – The Sun god Inti is angered; ceremonies are held to calm him.

9.🇰🇷 Korea (KR) – “Fire dogs” attempt to steal the Sun or Moon.

10.🇻🇳 Vietnam (VN) – A giant frog or toad swallows the Sun during an eclipse.

11.🇺🇸 Native American Tribes (US) – A sacred time for reflection, prayer, and renewal.

12.🇫🇷 Medieval Europe (FR) – Viewed as a warning sign of war, plague, or disaster.

13.🇪🇬 Ancient Egypt (EG) – A serpent attacks the Sun god Ra.

14.🇬🇭 Ghana (GH) – A moment for peace-making and resolving conflicts.

15.🇵🇭 Philippines (PH) – A mythical creature swallows the Moon; noise drives it away.

16.🌍 Modern Global Culture – Celebrated worldwide with viewing parties and scientific study.

TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Special traffic arrangements will be in place in connection with the Election for 25 Members of the Bar Council of Delhi at the Delhi High Court compound on 21st, 22nd & 23rd February 2026.

Timings: 09:00 AM – 06:00 PM

📍ROAD CLOSURE
-Sher Shah Road (from India Gate & Mathura Road sides) will remain closed during polling hours.

📍 ROUTES TO AVOID
-Tilak Marg
-C-Hexagon, India Gate
-Zakir Hussain Marg
-Sher Shah Road
-Purana Quila Road

📍PARKING & ADVISORY
-No halting/parking at C-Hexagon & surrounding roads; violators will be towed to Traffic Pit near Bhairon Mandir
-Advocates may park at Zoo Parking & Gate No. 5A, National Stadium
-Commuters are advised to avoid affected routes, use public transport & plan travel to ISBT/Railway Stations/Airports in advance.

📍Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels.

#DPTrafficAdvisory
